overdraft.note: Charged when we pay an item that overdraws your account. ATM and one-time debit card overdrafts are paid (and charged) only if you opted in to overdraft coverage.

nsf.note: Meridian does not charge a fee for returned (NSF) items.

overdraft_protection_transfer.note: Transfer from a linked savings account to cover an overdraft.

waived_if: $500 or more in monthly direct deposits

atm_out_of_network.note: Meridian's fee only. The ATM owner may charge its own fee; Meridian does not refund it.

foreign_transaction.note: Percent of each debit card purchase or ATM withdrawal made in a foreign currency.

early_account_closure.note: If the account is closed within 90 days of opening.

savings_excess_withdrawal.note: Per withdrawal after 6 withdrawals in a monthly statement cycle.
